props.name: collection
props.description: The collection of tree nodes

props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

props.name: canRename
props.description: Function to determine if a node can be renamed

props.name: checkedValue
props.description: The controlled checked node value

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the part.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes merged into the part's own classes with `cn`.

props.name: defaultCheckedValue
props.description:
The initial checked node value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the checked node value.

props.name: defaultExpandedValue
props.description:
The initial expanded node ids when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the expanded node value.

props.name: defaultFocusedValue
props.description:
The initial focused node value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the focused node value.

props.name: defaultSelectedValue
props.description:
The initial selected node value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the selected node value.

props.name: expandedValue
props.description: The controlled expanded node ids

props.name: expandOnClick
props.description: Whether clicking on a branch should open it or not

props.name: focusedValue
props.description: The value of the focused node

props.name: hideMode
props.description:
How to hide content when mounted but not present.
- `'display-none'`: HTML `hidden` attribute. Effects stay alive.
- `'activity'`: React 19 `<Activity mode="hidden">`. Effects pause. Requires React 19+.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the tree elements. Useful for composition.

props.name: lazyMount
props.description: Whether to enable lazy mounting

props.name: loadChildren
props.description:
Function to load children for a node asynchronously.
When provided, branches will wait for this promise to resolve before expanding.

props.name: onBeforeRename
props.description: Called before a rename is completed. Return false to prevent the rename.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called when the checked value changes

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when the tree is opened or closed

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Called when the focused node changes

props.name: onLoadChildrenComplete
props.description: Called when a node finishes loading children

props.name: onLoadChildrenError
props.description: Called when loading children fails for one or more nodes

props.name: onRenameComplete
props.description: Called when a node label rename is completed

props.name: onRenameStart
props.description: Called when a node starts being renamed

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes

props.name: scrollToIndexFn
props.description:
Function to scroll to a specific index.
Useful for virtualized tree views.

props.name: selectedValue
props.description: The controlled selected node value

props.name: selectionMode
props.description:
Whether the tree supports multiple selection
- "single": only one node can be selected
- "multiple": multiple nodes can be selected

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles applied to the rendered element.

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Whether the tree supports typeahead search

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description: Whether to unmount on exit.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value.
